# Third-party product mentions

CEMFORGE is a machine learning formulation engine trained on validated
3D-printed cementitious specimen data.

This file should NOT trigger claim.forbidden_absolute on "validated"
under default rules — the word is too overloaded across third-party
product mentions, ASTM-validated phrases, etc.

If a project wants this caught, it can opt in with
`forbidden_absolutes_extra: ["validated"]`.
